text:
Nora Singh: Hi all  first day remote from NZ. Laptop arrived, trying to get into Slack and the VPN. Who is my mentor and where do I pick up a badge if I visit the SF office? Fun fact: I bake tiny pavlovas.
Liam Chen: Welcome Nora! Im your mentor, nice to meet you. For Slack: use SSO with your @redwood.com. For VPN you need MDM enrolled first. If you ever visit SF, badge pickup is at Lobby A 9-5, bring photo ID.
Maya Patel: Hi Nora :wave: added you to #new-hires and #eng-oncall. We do a casual intro on Fridays at 12pm PT (optional).
it-bot: Note: VPN and internal services require device enrollment in CompanyMDM.
mdm-bot: To enroll: download CompanyMDM, open, sign in with @redwood.com, enter code emailed to you. Wait 5-10 minutes for policies to apply. Reply "enrolled" when done.
Nora Singh: Thanks! Installing MDM now. Quick ssh question: is access to build infra separate from jump host?
Liam Chen: Yes - jump host first, then we grant build infra after you	join the repos. If SSH trouble post the `ssh -v` output (mask hostnames).
Nora Singh: Enrolled and Slack working. Still need the repo permissions. Will ping if SSH hiccups persist. Also: tiny pavlovas for the first meetup when Im in SF :)
